model.selectionPolicy: Pre-registered fixed nuclides: Fe-56, Ni-62 and Pb-208; includes non-magic Fe-56, shell-sensitive doubly-magic Pb-208, and the empirical binding-per-nucleon maximum region Ni-62.

source.publication: The AME2020 atomic mass evaluation (I), Chinese Physics C 45, 030002 (2021); W.J. Huang, M. Wang, F.G. Kondev, G. Audi, S. Naimi

transform.conversion: divide the source BINDING ENERGY/A value and its uncertainty by 1000
transform.estimatedMarker: # in a value or uncertainty means AME2020 estimated/non-experimental; estimated rows are retained but excluded from validation status
transform.missingMarker: * means not calculable; such rows are excluded

provenance.replayInput: Pinned mass_1.mas20.txt bytes only; no network refetch permitted
provenance.independenceStatement: AME2020 evaluated atomic-mass observations are independent of the Genesis SEMF implementation; source values are not generated by Genesis.
provenance.uncertaintyStatement: The source uncertainty is retained; it describes the evaluated observation and does not represent SEMF model error.
limitations: comparison is against binding energy per nucleon only
this fixture does not establish calibration from three observations
source terms remain subject to review
